User-agent: *

# The admin panel is a private, noindex login screen. Keeping it out of the
# crawl budget entirely (it was previously crawlable and only excluded via a
# meta robots tag that Google has to render JavaScript to even see).
Disallow: /admin

# No value in indexing tracking/query permutations of the calculators.
Disallow: /*?q=
Disallow: /*?utm_

User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin

Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
